FAIL_TO_PASS: follow-pattern-parameters: retains side-effect-free code in pattern parameters called from try-statement-blocks
return-function-deoptimization: does not deoptimize call arguments of returned functions by default
parameter-variable-merge: correctly merges parameters and variable declarations
deopt-string-concatenation: deoptimize concatenation when used as an expression statement to better support es5-shim
supports-core-js: supports core-js feature detection (#2869)
deoptimize-logical-expression-reassignments: tracks reassignments of deoptimized logical expressions
unmodified-default-exports-function-argument: passing unbound default export to function cannot rebind it
property-keys-not-renamed: does not rename property keys
smallest: handles treeshake preset "smallest"
async-function-effects: tracks effects when awaiting thenables
imports-are-deconflicted-b: deconflicts imports (redux)
deoptimize-computed-class-keys: deoptimizes computed class property keys
track-rest-parameter-value: determines the correct value of rest parameters when a function is called multiple times
system-uninitialized: supports uninitialized binding exports
namespace-import-deoptimization: includes namespace import properties accessed in try-catch callbacks
literals-from-return-expressions: tracks literal values across return expressions
safest: handles treeshake preset "safest"
side-effects-static-methods: allow calls to pure static methods to be tree-shaken
reexport-function: function parameters tree-shaken should support reexport
externally-reassigned-named-exports: calls to externally reassigned methods of named exports must be retained
